corrections.text: The article's Migration section states that, per VentureBeat's September 10 report, DeepSeek said calls to the 'deepseek-v4-pro' API identifier would route to V4.1-Flash starting September 14, 2026. DeepSeek's own pricing documentation, current as of this review on September 16, states the company reversed that plan: 'we have decided to continue providing API services for DeepSeek V4 Pro after September 14, 2026, with the billing method remaining unchanged.' deepseek-v4-pro continues to be served as a separate model, not routed to V4.1-Flash.
